entry.author: Te Puni Kōkiri
entry.summary:
Parininihi ki Waitotara Incorporation (PKW) manages 20,000 hectares of whenua Māori in Taranaki and represents the interests of over 10,500 shareholders. 
Building from a solid foundation in dairy farming, it has evolved into a richly diverse agri-business. But, with the shadow of the Taranaki land confiscations of the 1860s always present, the heart of PKW’s role is in bringing whānau and whenua together. When whānau and whenua are connected, both will thrive.
